definitions.explanation: to be conspicuous; to be prominent; to be particularly noticeable among others

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{美|うつく}しさが{際立|きわだ}っている。
{赤|あか}い{色|いろ}が{際立|きわだ}って{見|み}える。
examples.english: The red color is strikingly visible.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{才能|さいのう}は{同僚|どうりょう}の{中|なか}で{際立|きわだ}っている。
examples.english: His talent stands out among his colleagues.

notes:
{際立|きわだ}つ is an intransitive godan verb meaning "to stand out" or "to be conspicuous." It describes something being noticeably different or prominent compared to its surroundings.

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive counterpart is {際立|きわだ}たせる (to make something stand out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {際立|きわだ}って{美|うつく}しい (strikingly beautiful)
- {際立|きわだ}った{特徴|とくちょう} (distinctive feature)
- {際立|きわだ}った{存在感|そんざいかん} (striking presence)
- {際立|きわだ}った{違|ちが}い (notable difference)

USAGE PATTERNS:
- Often used with ている to describe a current state: {際立|きわだ}っている (stands out)
- The past participle {際立|きわだ}った is commonly used as an adjective

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {目立|めだ}つ: More common, general "to stand out"
- {際立|きわだ}つ: More literary, emphasizes contrast with surroundings

REGISTER: Neutral to slightly literary.
